name: subsurf
description: SubSurf — discovery scan dużej infrastruktury (HackNation 2026, CBI AGH)

scripts.dojo:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d defectdojo-nginx defectdojo-celeryworker defectdojo-celerybeat
scripts.dojo:logs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml logs -f defectdojo-initializer defectdojo-uwsgi defectdojo-celeryworker defectdojo-celerybeat defectdojo-nginx
scripts.workers:manager: mkdir -p worker-results && WORKER_UID=$(id -u) WORKER_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.workers.yml run --rm --build worker-manager
scripts.workers:manager:poll: mkdir -p worker-results && WORKER_UID=$(id -u) WORKER_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.workers.yml run --rm --build worker-manager --poll --output-dir /results
scripts.workers:nmap:build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.workers.yml --profile nmap build nmap-worker
scripts.workers:httpx:build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.workers.yml --profile httpx build httpx-worker
scripts.workers:tlsx:build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.workers.yml --profile tlsx build tlsx-worker
